stem: Which sentence can BEST follow and support sentence 25?

options.label: A
options.text: Everyone in our group gets along well, and I think you will enjoy our company at the farm.

options.label: B
options.text: I am very pleased that I came across your website when I was searching the internet for a place to volunteer.

options.label: C
options.text: We will work alongside you to plant crops, pull weeds, harvest vegetables, or anything else you need us to do.

options.label: D
options.text: Next year, it is possible that we will look for a different opportunity to serve in our community.
